segments.text: When opening the gas cylinder valve, position yourself so the regulator outlet flow valve is pointing away from your body.
segments.zh: 打开气瓶阀时，你所站的位置要让减压阀的出口流量阀朝向远离身体的方向。

segments.text: Do not put your hand on top of the valve as you open it.
segments.zh: 打开阀门时，不要把手放在阀门顶部。

segments.text: Slowly open the valve by hand unless a vendor-supplied tool is required.
segments.zh: 用手缓慢地打开阀门，除非需要使用厂商提供的工具。

segments.text: Check the inlet pressure gauge to ensure it registers the expected value.
segments.zh: 检查进口压力表，确认它显示的是预期的数值。

segments.text: Contact your laboratory supervisor if pressure is less than expected.
segments.zh: 如果压力低于预期，请联系你的实验室主管。

segments.text: Low cylinder pressure may indicate a near-empty cylinder or a leaking valve which can be a serious safety issue.
segments.zh: 气瓶压力低可能说明气瓶快空了，或者阀门漏气，这可能是严重的安全问题。

segments.text: Slowly turn the regulator control valve until the regulator pressure is at the desired level.
segments.zh: 缓慢旋转减压阀的调压阀，直到减压阀压力达到所需的水平。

segments.text: Do not assume that the maximum scale reading on the gauge is the safe working pressure.
segments.zh: 不要以为压力表上的最大刻度读数就是安全工作压力。

segments.text: Slowly open the outlet flow valve on the regulator to start the gas flow to your system.
segments.zh: 缓慢打开减压阀上的出口流量阀，开始向你的系统供气。

segments.text: Do not use the outlet flow valve to control pressure, only gas flow.
segments.zh: 不要用出口流量阀来控制压力，它只控制气体流量。

segments.text: Pressure is set with the regulator control valve.
segments.zh: 压力是用减压阀的调压阀来设定的。

segments.text: After flow is established, the set delivery pressure may decrease slightly.
segments.zh: 建立流量之后，设定的输出压力可能会略有下降。

segments.text: Check to see that the delivery pressure is as desired and make any necessary adjustments.
segments.zh: 检查输出压力是否符合要求，并进行必要的调整。
